title: Yocan Kodo Plus 510 Battery
description:
The Kodo Plus 510 Battery from Yocan is a compact and portable 510-threaded device designed for convenience. It features a 900mAh battery with USB Type-C charging for quick recharges, preset voltage settings for tailored experiences, and two-button operation for ease of use.

Built with high-quality materials and a sleek design, it’s an excellent choice when you need your hit on the go.

Product Features:
– 900 mAh Battery Capacity
– USB Type-C Charging Technology
– Preset Voltage Settings
– Two-button Operation
– 510-threaded Connection
– Small, Portable
– Premium Finish

What’s Included:
1 x Kodo Plus 510 Battery

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.
